title: The people too many
english: A huge host against Israel; the Lord: [[The people with you are too many; I will not give Midian into their hand, lest Israel boast >> Bible:Judges 7:2]]. [[Whoever does not hate father and mother >> Bible:Luke 14:26]] — Christ’s militia renounces.

title: Water-lapping test — three hundred
english: [[Those who lap water with the tongue — three hundred >> Bible:Judges 7:5-7]] — a sacrament of number and sobriety. [[The Lord is my light and my salvation — whom shall I fear? >> Bible:Psalm 27:1]].

title: SERIES CLOSEOUT — trumpets jars lamps
english: [[With trumpet, jars, and lamps the enemies turn their backs >> Bible:Judges 7:16-22]]. The shout: Sword of the Lord and of Gideon. May we be enrolled among the three hundred. Rufinus’s nine Judges homilies are complete. Glory to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit forever. Amen.
